entities.summary: Sassanid Empire, a political institution in Kuwait during Pre-Islamic and Early Islamic Kuwait (632–750). Grew from Characene and Characene and Sassanid Gulf. Led to the emergence of Islamic Conquest and Kazima and Muslim.
